Our consultancy, Apex Luxury Automotive, is preparing a comprehensive client briefing for Mr. Wei Jiaming, a high-net-worth individual who is seriously considering purchasing a Lamborghini. He needs a single, authoritative reference document before making his decision.

Please read the brief request file located at `/workspace/client_files/CLIENT_BRIEF_REQUEST.txt` and produce the requested output file `lamborghini_client_brief.json` in valid JSON format.

Be aware: there are various draft documents and notes scattered around the workspace from previous research that may contain outdated or unverified figures. The final brief must reflect only accurate, verified information. The document will be presented directly to the client, so precision matters — especially for financial terms, technical specifications, dealer addresses, and warranty details.
